{"metadata":{"description":"English ｜ 中文","id":"gh:1338123290","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-memory","slug":"LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-memory"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** ｜ 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — a portable markdown memory store with a soul, injected at "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"every session start."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**macOS · Windows · Linux** · Node ≥ 18 · DSH `^0.2.1-rc.5` · MIT"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A Cordis plugin that gives DSH agents **persistent, cross-session, migratable memory**: plain markdo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"wn + git (the *LLM Wiki* pattern), a `SOUL.md` persona, and a boot block **auto-injected through run"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"time context** — a hard guarantee, not a hope that the model decides to call a skill."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Or install from a **plugin index**: enable *Custom plugin indexes* under **Plugins → Experimental**,"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" open **Discover → Add index source**, paste"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"then install **Memory** from the list. (A JSON index in the official format, served from this repo.)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"2. **Restart the app.** In the first session the agent starts the **soul-forging** conversation itse"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"lf (or skip it: **Settings → Memory → Basic soul**, one save).
3. **Verify:** `dsh-memory doctor`, o"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"r open **Settings → Memory** for the health dashboard and hot settings."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Remembering across sessions** — boot block = SOUL + MEMORY protocol + `index.md` + recent activi"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ty, with a per-file budget so the index tail is not truncated first.
- **A soul, not just storage** "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"— SOUL + BOOTSTRAP forging; a quick-setup card writes a managed block; persona names are read from S"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"OUL, never hard-coded.
- **You stay in control** — per-session switch (chip / `/memory on|off` / pan"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"el) and `disabledWorkspaces` defaults.
- **A companion** — digest nudge, proactive recall, weekly gr"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"owth recap, context-sensitive tone; shared speech floor with other proactive plugins.
- **Portable**"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" — plain markdown + git, `pack`/`unpack`, optional auto-commit.
- **Memory graph** — interactive 3D "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"sphere: rotate / zoom / drag nodes, search-to-focus, hover or click to light up neighbours; select a"},{"id":"p14s9","text":" node → **Reveal in Finder** or **Copy path**.
- **Health tools** — dashboard, `checkup`, `lint`, `d"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"octor`, automatic `last_access` stamping.
- **Zero build, bilingual panel, hot-editable config.**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Basic soul (quick forging)** — set the agent's name, what it calls you and a baseline persona in o"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ne save; the next session uses it, no restart. Chat-forged souls are echoed back from `SOUL.md`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Memory graph (3D)** — a live projection of the store: rotate / wheel-zoom / drag nodes to arrange,"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" search-to-focus (the camera flies to the hit), hover or click to light up the neighbourhood. Select"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" a node to **Reveal in Finder** or **Copy path**; double-click empty space to reset."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Settings panel** — sixteen settings apply immediately (per-session switch, boot gates, recall cade"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nce, tone, disabled workspaces…). The health dashboard and the graph sit right below."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Cross-platform"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**macOS, Windows and Linux are supported.** Path settings expand `~`, `~\`, `%USERPROFILE%` and `$HO"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ME`; CRLF files are parsed as LF and **written back with their own newline style**; *Reveal in Finde"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"r* maps to `open -R` (macOS), `explorer /select,` (Windows, space-safe argv) and `xdg-open` (Linux);"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" `disabledWorkspaces` matching is case-insensitive on Windows. Details: docs/CONFIGURATION.md."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Sixteen hot keys edit live under **Settings → Memory**. The full table, boot-budget rules and compos"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ition overrides are in docs/CONFIGURATION.md."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## CLI"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Store resolution: `$MEMORY_DIR` → `./.memory` → `~/.memory`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Docs"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Configuration · Design notes · Migration · Proactive protocol · Contributing · Security · Changelog"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## FAQ"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Does it burn tokens every request?** No — runtime context is deduplicated by projection; an unchan"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ged payload is injected once.
**File skill vs plugin?** The file skill is a soft guarantee (only its"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" blurb is injected); this plugin is a hard one. They coexist (the file skill ranks higher); remove a"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ny hand-written persona to avoid double injection.
**Where should the store live?** `~/.memory` by d"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"efault; point `memoryDir` inside a project for isolation."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Zero build: `lib/` is runtime code as-is.
